hero.title: WHERE SOUND, SKILL, AND CREATIVE CONFIDENCE ARE BUILT.
hero.subtitle: Tripod Creative Agency offers recording, music production, podcast support, and practical instrument training inside a working studio environment.

zones.title: Five studio lanes arranged like one working creative room.
zones.body: Each zone is practical, hands-on, and shaped around how Tripod records, coaches, rehearses, and develops creative work.

recordingStudio.label: Tracking Room
recordingStudio.title: Recording Studio
recordingStudio.description: A focused room for vocals, voice work, demos, and guided recording sessions that help creators grow comfortable behind the mic.

musicProduction.label: Production Desk
musicProduction.title: Music Production
musicProduction.description: Build beats, shape arrangements, and move rough ideas into stronger drafts with studio guidance and a clean workflow.

podcastSetup.label: Voice Booth
podcastSetup.title: Podcast Setup
podcastSetup.description: Create spoken-word sessions, interviews, and voice-led content in a setup that keeps the conversation clear and controlled.

instrumentTraining.label: Practice Corner
instrumentTraining.title: Instrument Training
instrumentTraining.description: Hands-on piano, guitar, drums, and vocal practice designed to build rhythm, confidence, and repetition inside the studio.

creativePracticeSessions.label: Creator Lab
creativePracticeSessions.title: Creative Practice Sessions
creativePracticeSessions.description: A flexible lane for rehearsal, idea development, repetition, and confidence-building inside a real studio rhythm.

path.title: A development path that moves from first session to finished output.
path.body: This path reflects how Tripod supports creators in practice: understand the goal, build confidence, record with purpose, and leave with something useful.

steps.title: Choose Your Focus
steps.description: Start with the instrument, voice, session type, or production goal you want to improve.

steps.title: Understand the Setup
steps.description: Learn the tools, signal flow, and studio habits that make recording and practice more effective.

steps.title: Practice with Direction
steps.description: Build control through repetition, guided feedback, and practical session time.

steps.title: Record / Produce
steps.description: Move into takes, drafts, beats, edits, or voice capture once the creative direction feels ready.

steps.title: Leave with Usable Output
steps.description: Finish with a draft, recording, rehearsal milestone, or next-step plan you can build on.

atmosphere.title: Microphones, instruments, coaching, and session energy in one room.
atmosphere.body: The atmosphere is practical and encouraging, giving creators space to rehearse, record, and improve inside a working production environment.

cta.title: STEP INTO THE STUDIO AND BUILD YOUR NEXT RECORDING.
cta.subtitle: Start with a session, ask about training, or open a WhatsApp conversation and Tripod will guide the next step.
